section.title: org.osgi.service.dal.functions
section.para: Device Abstraction Layer Functions Package 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

listitem.para: Alarm - Alarm function provides alarm sensor support.
BooleanControl - BooleanControl function provides a boolean control support.
BooleanSensor - BooleanSensor function provides boolean sensor monitoring.
Keypad - Keypad function provides support for keypad control.
Meter - Meter function can measure metering information.
MultiLevelControl - MultiLevelControl function provides multi-level control support.
MultiLevelSensor - MultiLevelSensor function provides multi-level sensor monitoring.
Types - Shares common constants for all functions defined in this package.
WakeUp - WakeUp function provides device awake monitoring.

section.title: public interface Alarm extends Function
section.para: Alarm function provides alarm sensor support. There is only one eventable property and no operations.

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_ALARM = "alarm"
section.para: Specifies the alarm property name. The property is eventable.

section.title: public interface BooleanControl extends Function
section.para: BooleanControl function provides a boolean control support. The eventable function state is accessible with getData() getter and setData(boolean) setter. The state can be reversed with inverse() method, can be set to true value with setTrue() method and can be set to false value with setFalse() method.
The control type can be:

listitem.para: other type defined in Types
custom - vendor specific type

section.title: public static final String OPERATION_INVERSE = "inverse"
section.para: Specifies the inverse operation name. The operation can be executed with inverse() method.

section.title: public static final String OPERATION_SET_FALSE = "setFalse"
section.para: Specifies the operation name, which sets the control state to false value. The operation can be executed with setFalse() method.

section.title: public static final String OPERATION_SET_TRUE = "setTrue"
section.para: Specifies the operation name, which sets the control state to true value. The operation can be executed with setTrue() method.

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_DATA = "data"
section.para: Specifies the state property name. The eventable property value is accessible with getData() method.

section.title: public BooleanData getData() throws DeviceException
section.para: Returns the current state of BooleanControl. It's a getter method for PROPERTY_DATA property.

section.para: Reverses the BooleanControl state. If the current state represents true value, it'll be changed to false. If the current state represents false value, it'll be changed to true. The operation name is OPERATION_INVERSE.

section.title: public interface Keypad extends Function
section.para: Keypad function provides support for keypad control. The keypad typically consists of one or more keys/buttons, which can be discerned. Different types of key presses like short and long press can typically also be detected. Each key pressed event is followed by a key released event. It's not possible to have two consecutive key pressed or key released events. There is only one eventable property and no operations.
Keypad can enumerate all supported keys in the key property metadata, PropertyMetadata.getEnumValues(String).

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_KEY = "key"
section.para: Specifies a property name for a key from the keypad. The property is eventable.

section.title: public interface Types
section.para: Shares common constants for all functions defined in this package. The defined function types are mapped as follow:

listitem.para: LIGHT - MultiLevelControl, MultiLevelSensor, BooleanSensor and BooleanControl
TEMPERATURE - MultiLevelControl and MultiLevelSensor
FLOW - MultiLevelControl and MultiLevelSensor
PRESSURE - MultiLevelControl, MultiLevelSensor and Meter
HUMIDITY - MultiLevelControl and MultiLevelSensor
GAS - MultiLevelControl, MultiLevelSensor, BooleanSensor and Meter
SMOKE - MultiLevelControl, MultiLevelSensor and BooleanSensor
DOOR - MultiLevelControl, MultiLevelSensor, BooleanSensor and BooleanControl
WINDOW - MultiLevelControl, MultiLevelSensor, BooleanSensor and BooleanControl
LIQUID - MultiLevelControl and MultiLevelSensor
POWER - MultiLevelControl, MultiLevelSensor, BooleanSensor, BooleanControl and Meter
NOISINESS - MultiLevelControl and MultiLevelSensor
RAIN - MultiLevelSensor and BooleanSensor
CONTACT - BooleanSensor
FIRE - BooleanSensor
OCCUPANCY - BooleanSensor
WATER - BooleanSensor and Meter
MOTION - BooleanSensor
HEAT - Meter
COLD - Meter

section.para: The mapping is not mandatory. The function can use custom defined types.

section.para: The function type is applicable to:

listitem.para: Meter - indicates that the Meter measures thermal energy provided by a source.

section.para: This type can be specified as a value of org.osgi.service.dal.Function.SERVICE_TYPE.

section.title: public static final String DOOR = "door"

BooleanSensor - indicates that the BooleanSensor can detect the door state. true state means that the door is opened. false state means that the door is closed.
BooleanControl - indicates that there is a door position control. true state means that the door will be opened. false state means that the door will be closed.

section.title: public interface WakeUp extends Function
section.para: WakeUp function provides device awake monitoring. It's especially applicable to battery-operated devices. Such device can notify the system that it's awake and can receive commands with a PROPERTY_AWAKE property event.
The device can periodically wake up for commands. The interval can be managed with PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL property.

formalpara.title: See Also
formalpara.para: LevelData, BooleanData

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_AWAKE = "awake"
section.para: Specifies the awake property name. The property access type can be PropertyMetadata.ACCESS_EVENTABLE. If the device is awake, it will trigger a property event.
The property value type is BooleanData. The boolean data is always true. It marks that the device is awake.

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL = "wakeUpInterval"
section.para: Specifies the wake up interval. The device can periodically wake up and receive commands. That interval is managed by this eventable property. The current property value is available with getWakeUpInterval() and can be modified with setWakeUpInterval(BigDecimal, String).

section.title: public LevelData getWakeUpInterval() throws DeviceException
section.para: Returns the current wake up interval. It's a getter method for PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL property. The device can periodically wake up and receive command based on this interval.
The interval can be measured in different units like hours, minutes, seconds, etc. The unit is specified in LevelData instance.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The current wake up interval.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If this function service object has already been unregistered.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: DeviceException– If an operation error is available.

section.title: public void setWakeUpInterval(BigDecimal interval, String unit) throws DeviceException

formalpara.title: interval
formalpara.para: The new wake up interval.

formalpara.title: unit
formalpara.para: The interval unit. If the unit is null, the interval is measured in milliseconds.

section.para: Sets wake up interval according to the specified unit. It's a setter method for PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL property. The device can periodically wake up and receive command based on this interval. The unit can be null, then the interval is measured in milliseconds.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If this function service object has already been unregistered.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: DeviceException– If an operation error is available.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If there is an invalid argument.
